questions.question: From the workspace-finished overlay task, a sub-agent proposed 3 reusable conventions not yet documented (a 4th, the controlled-textarea state-during-render technique, was deemed a one-off and left out). Which should I capture via task-add-coding-pattern-or-design?

options.label: Overlay anchored to column
options.description: coding design — fixed-overlay-anchored-to-content-column: fixed overlays re-centered/width-clamped to the page's max-w-120 column (left-1/2 w-full max-w-120 -translate-x-1/2), mirroring header/footer; z-40 below z-50 chrome.

options.label: Decorative overlay pointer-events-none
options.description: coding pattern (general-coding-practices.md) — feedback-only overlays are marked pointer-events-none so underlying content stays interactive.

options.label: Derived muted flag
options.description: coding pattern (general-coding-practices.md) — express dimmed/struck-through state via a single derived boolean (isMuted = done || finished) consumed by cn(), not repeated status comparisons.

options.label: Capture none
options.description: Don't document any of these now; leave the registries unchanged.
